messages:
eli: Heads up — we're seeing a sustained apiserver 503 spike in eu-central1 since ~03:10 UTC. LB rewrite toggled an old target group and ALB is sending some traffic to backends that fail health checks. GPU onboarding backlog jumped ~4x. oncall, triage? :eyes:

Tim-oncall: I'm on it. apiserver latency +5xx in metrics. apiserver pods healthy but tcp_syn backlog high. grabbing HAProxy & ALB logs now.

sam: ```
[03:11:42] ALB -> target-old/10.2.5.12: request failed, HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
[03:11:47] target-old healthcheck: 502 /healthz
[03:12:02] conntrack table use: 89% (conntrack count 526k)
```

maria: infra-deploy bot shows nginx-lb-config rolled at 2024-09-03T03:12:08Z by infra-deploy with flag enable_old_backend_rewrite=true. That matches timing.

infra-deploy-bot: deploy infra/nginx-lb-config by infra-deploy at 2024-09-03T03:12:08Z — change: enable_old_backend_rewrite=true

anna: Plan: 1) revert LB config, 2) throttle GPU onboarding to stop heavy attach churn, 3) bump apiserver replicas temporarily and reduce conntrack timeouts. Revert first.

Tim-oncall: rolling revert: `infra-cli rollback infra/nginx-lb-config --to previous` — applying now. Scaling down onboarder: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy gpu-onboarder --replicas=1` (was 4)

sam: Revert applied, ALB now routes to current target group. Patching conntrack timeout: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=180` on kube-proxy nodes (propagating via daemonset). Also `kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy apiserver --replicas=5` for headroom.

maria: Added temporary feature-flag to reject new large attach batches for 10m. Filed infra ticket INFRA-1219 to require canary & gating for LB rewrites.

eli: Metrics: 5xxs dropped to baseline by 03:24 UTC, watch reconnects and onboard backlog trending down. Cost note: provisioning churn caused ~2 reserved GPU-hours extra — filed chargeback note for product-cost.

elembot: incident created: INC-20240903-4575 (apiserver-lb-rewrite) — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apiserver-lb-rewrite

Tim-oncall: Monitoring stable. Keeping onboarder scaled down until Viktor approves. Closing thread unless new spikes. :thumbsup:
